fields.description: Original filename as uploaded.
fields.label: Source Filename

fields.description: Detected file extension (lowercase, no dot).
fields.label: File Extension

fields.description: Intake channel that originated this capture: manual ERPNext upload, inbound email, mobile upload, or vendor portal pull.
fields.label: Intake Channel
fields.options:
Manual ERPNext Upload
Email Inbound
Mobile Upload
Vendor Portal Pull

fields.description: Native Frappe File record that preserves the original upload. Either this or Source File URL must be present.
fields.label: Source File

fields.description: Direct URL or traceable reference to the original source image. Populated automatically from the linked File when available.
fields.label: Source File URL

fields.description: Time the source artifact was received for intake.
fields.label: Received At

fields.description: Provisional Receipt-vs-Invoice stream set at intake (spec 02). Step-6 classification may revise it.
fields.label: Stream

fields.description: Which signal fired the provisional stream tag (e.g. filename:receipt_*, sender_domain, body:PAID, default).
fields.label: Stream Provisional Source

fields.description: Set by Step-6 classification to the prior stream value when the tag is revised; the audit trail for a mis-tag.
fields.label: Stream Revised From

fields.description: 72h SimpleFIN match deadline (Stream R only): received_at + 72h. NULL for Invoice / Unclassified.
fields.label: SLA Due At

fields.description: Pre-accounting lifecycle state. This capture is NOT a Purchase Invoice and does not imply approval or payment.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending Review
Unsupported
Rejected
Proposed
Needs Correction
Confirmed
Duplicate

fields.description: 1 if the uploaded source format is supported (PDF/PNG/JPG/JPEG).
fields.label: Supported Format

fields.description: 1 if AP clerk action is required before this capture can progress.
fields.label: Action Required

fields.description: Short reason action is required (e.g. 'Pending AP review', 'Unsupported format').
fields.label: Action Required Reason

fields.description: Optional human-readable context about where this source came from.
fields.label: Source Context

fields.description: Validation/rejection details. Populated when the file is unsupported or otherwise blocked.
fields.label: Validation Message

fields.description: Pre-extraction duplicate-detection audit fields (spec 03). The dedupe step runs before OCR so a re-upload spends no extraction cost.
fields.label: Deduplication

fields.description: MD5 exact-bytes hash, copied from the linked File's content_hash (Frappe core computes it). Used for the exact re-upload check. Indexed; intentionally NOT unique (a legitimate duplicate is a second row with the same hash).
fields.label: Content Hash (MD5)

fields.description: Perceptual hash (pHash hex) of the rasterized first page, for near-duplicate (re-scan) detection. Empty when poppler/imagehash is unavailable — dedupe then degrades to exact-only.
fields.label: Perceptual Hash

fields.description: The oldest prior capture this one exactly duplicates. Set on an exact content-hash hit (and on a human-confirmed perceptual hit), never auto-set for a mere visual suspect.
fields.label: Duplicate Of

fields.description: Timestamp the dedupe verdict was recorded. Stamped on every dedupe run (clean, suspect, or duplicate); also the 'already deduped' guard for the pre-OCR cascade hop.
fields.label: Duplicate Detected At

fields.description: Assistive AI/OCR proposal. NON-AUTHORITATIVE — values here are suggestions only and require AP review before any downstream use.
fields.label: AI / OCR Proposal (Non-Authoritative)

fields.description: Identifier of the extraction provider that produced this proposal (e.g. 'fake-deterministic-v1').
fields.label: OCR Provider

fields.description: Lifecycle of the OCR proposal independent of overall capture status.
fields.label: OCR Status
fields.options:
Not Extracted
Proposed
Confirmed
Needs Correction

fields.description: Timestamp the OCR proposal was generated.
fields.label: OCR Extracted At

fields.description: Proposed supplier name (assistive). Not authoritative until AP review.
fields.label: Proposed Supplier

fields.description: Proposed supplier invoice / receipt number (assistive).
fields.label: Proposed Supplier Invoice No

fields.description: Proposed invoice date (assistive).
fields.label: Proposed Invoice Date

fields.description: Proposed total amount (assistive).
fields.label: Proposed Total Amount

fields.description: Proposed ISO-4217 currency code (assistive).
fields.label: Proposed Currency

fields.description: Comma-separated list of mandatory header fields the extractor could not propose. Blocks silent progression.
fields.label: Proposed Missing Fields

fields.description: Comma-separated list of mandatory header fields the extractor flagged as ambiguous / low-confidence.
fields.label: Proposed Ambiguous Fields

fields.description: Raw JSON payload from the OCR provider, preserved for auditability.
fields.label: OCR Raw Response

fields.description: AP-reviewed values. These are the authoritative header values intended for downstream use; remain empty until AP review confirms or corrects the proposal.
fields.label: AP Review (Authoritative)

fields.description: AP-reviewed supplier name. Authoritative.
fields.label: Supplier (Reviewed)

fields.description: AP-reviewed supplier invoice / receipt number. Authoritative.
fields.label: Supplier Invoice No (Reviewed)

fields.description: AP-reviewed invoice date. Authoritative.
fields.label: Invoice Date (Reviewed)

fields.description: AP-reviewed total amount. Authoritative.
fields.label: Total Amount (Reviewed)

fields.description: AP-reviewed currency. Authoritative.
fields.label: Currency (Reviewed)

fields.description: User who confirmed / corrected the OCR proposal.
fields.label: Reviewed By

fields.description: Timestamp the AP review was recorded.
fields.label: Reviewed At

fields.description: Optional notes left by the AP reviewer (e.g. corrections rationale).
fields.label: Review Notes

fields.description: Validation outcome of the AP-reviewed capture against existing ERPNext records prior to Purchase Invoice promotion.
fields.label: Validation & Match

fields.description: Existing ERPNext Supplier matched from the reviewed final_supplier value. Unknown suppliers are not auto-created.
fields.label: Matched Supplier

fields.description: Outcome of the supplier match step.
fields.label: Supplier Match Status

fields.description: Optional explicit reference to an existing Purchase Order.
fields.label: Purchase Order Reference

fields.description: Optional explicit reference to an existing Purchase Receipt.
fields.label: Purchase Receipt Reference

fields.description: Explicit classification of how the capture references prior purchasing documents.
fields.label: Purchase Reference Status
fields.options:
Not Validated
Non-PO / Not Applicable
Purchase Order
Purchase Receipt

fields.description: Overall validation outcome. 'Validated' is required before promotion to Purchase Invoice.
fields.label: Validation Status

fields.description: Human-readable validation outcome detail (e.g. list of blocking issues, or a success summary).
fields.label: Validation Result

fields.description: User (or system actor) who recorded the validation outcome.
fields.label: Validated By

fields.description: Timestamp the validation outcome was recorded.
fields.label: Validated At

fields.description: Identifier of the validation routine / source (e.g. 'ap-validation-v1').
fields.label: Validation Source

fields.description: Promotion of the validated capture into the native Purchase Invoice lifecycle.
fields.label: Purchase Invoice Promotion

fields.description: Native ERPNext Purchase Invoice created from this capture (header-only Phase 1).
fields.label: Purchase Invoice

fields.description: Whether this capture has been promoted into the native Purchase Invoice lifecycle.
fields.label: Promotion Status

fields.description: Approval routing and decision audit. Phase 1: manager approval also authorizes mock payment release; no separate payment-release authority.
fields.label: Approval & Routing

fields.description: Approval routing outcome. Captures that are not yet routed remain at Not Required.
fields.label: Approval Status
fields.options:
Not Required
Auto Approved
Pending Manager
Manager Approved
Rejected

fields.description: Auto-approval threshold used for this routing decision.
fields.label: Approval Threshold

fields.description: Identifier of the configuration source for the threshold (e.g. 'ap-approval-v1').
fields.label: Approval Threshold Source

fields.description: Human-readable explanation of why this capture auto-approved or routed to manager.
fields.label: Routing Reason

fields.description: Role required to record the manager decision when routed for manager approval.
fields.label: Assigned Approver Role

fields.description: User (or system actor) that recorded the approval / rejection decision.
fields.label: Decision By

fields.description: Timestamp the approval / rejection decision was recorded.
fields.label: Decision At

fields.description: Optional notes left by the approver or rejector.
fields.label: Decision Notes

fields.description: Whether this capture may proceed to the later mock payment slice. Phase 1 only: no Payment Entry or Bank Transaction is created here.
fields.label: Payment Readiness
fields.options:
Not Ready
Ready for Payment
Blocked

fields.description: Deterministic mock payment writeback. This section uses native Payment Entry and must never imply real funds or bank reconciliation.
fields.label: Mock Payment

fields.description: Native ERPNext Payment Entry created for the mock payment.
fields.label: Payment Entry

fields.description: Derived payment lifecycle status for the pilot.
fields.label: Payment Lifecycle Status

fields.description: Mock/null payment provider identifier.
fields.label: Mock Payment Provider

fields.description: Deterministic mock provider transaction/reference id.
fields.label: Mock Payment Reference

fields.description: Mock provider status returned for this payment.
fields.label: Mock Payment Status

fields.description: Amount confirmed by the deterministic mock provider.
fields.label: Mock Payment Amount

fields.description: Timestamp the deterministic mock payment was issued.
fields.label: Mock Payment Issued At

fields.description: Raw deterministic mock provider response for audit.
fields.label: Mock Payment Response
